exposure: Delivery mode (cesarean or operative vaginal vs spontaneous vaginal)
outcome: Type of early postpartum encounter (in-person, telephone/patient portal, or both)
cohort: Postpartum persons who received prenatal care and delivered at a single academic level IV maternity care center in 2019
finding: Early postpartum encounters were more common among primiparas and postpartum persons who were breastfeeding or had prolonged hospitalization, episiotomy, cesarean delivery, or operative vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Postpartum persons who had cesarean or operative vaginal delivery were significantly more likely to initiate early postpartum encounters than those who had spontaneous vaginal delivery.
